method: WCAG 2.2 relative luminance; ratios unrounded. Text needs 4.5:1, non-text indicators and boundaries 3:1.
rendered: pnpm smoke re-reads every pair whose "rendered" is "static" or "focus" from computed styles in Chromium and prints the ratios in its design report; "token-only" pairs (hover, placeholder, sidebar placements, the agent symbol image, focus inside an open menu) are recorded here only.

The required name is the accessible identity and the initials are measured against the disc; the disc outline itself carries no information.
The count text is measured against its fill and the accessible text names what is counted; the fill edge carries no further information.
Each segment is identified by its measured text label; the outline around the group is decorative.
Selection is carried by aria-selected and by the weight-500 text-primary label against weight-400 muted labels; the pale fill is supplementary, as DESIGN.md specifies it.
The floating list is identified by its measured item text and the popover shadow; the pale border is decorative.
